UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && echo  | base64 -d > start-modded.sh && chmod +x start-modded.sh && echo Launch script updated"

-c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; MIH=1.66.1; if [ ! -x mc-image-helper-$MIH/bin/mc-image-helper ]; then echo Downloading mc-image-helper $MIH; rm -rf mc-image-helper-* mih.tgz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO mih.tgz https://github.com/itzg/mc-image-helper/releases/download/$MIH/mc-image-helper-$MIH.tgz || { echo ERROR: mc-image-helper download failed; exit 1; }; tar -xzf mih.tgz && rm -f mih.tgz; fi; ln -sfn mc-image-helper-$MIH .mih && echo mc-image-helper $MIH ready"

-c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; A=x64; case $(uname -m) in aarch64|arm64) A=aarch64;; esac; for v in 21 {{JavaVersion}}; do case $v in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac; if [ ! -x jre/$v/bin/java ]; then echo Downloading Temurin JRE $v; mkdir -p jre/$v && wget -qO jre$v.tgz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/$v/ga/linux/$A/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse || { echo ERROR: JRE $v download failed; exit 1; }; tar -xzf jre$v.tgz -C jre/$v --strip-components=1 && rm -f jre$v.tgz; fi; done; echo Java runtimes ready"

-c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; URL='{{PageURL}}'; if [ -z \"$URL\" ]; then echo Modpack Page URL is not set, skipping modpack install. Set it under Configuration, then click Update again.; exit 0; fi; export CF_API_KEY='{{CFAPIKey}}'; if [ -z \"$CF_API_KEY\" ]; then echo ERROR: A CurseForge API key is required. Get one free at https://console.curseforge.com and set it under Configuration.; exit 1; fi; export JAVA_HOME=\"$PWD/jre/21\"; export PATH=\"$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH\"; EXTRA=''; XL='{{ExcludeMods}}'; [ -n \"$XL\" ] && EXTRA=\"$EXTRA --excludes=$XL\"; IL='{{ForceIncludeMods}}'; [ -n \"$IL\" ] && EXTRA=\"$EXTRA --force-includes=$IL\"; case '{{ForceSynchronise}}' in true|True) EXTRA=\"$EXTRA --force-synchronize\";; esac; XIF='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/master/files/cf-exclude-include.json'; if wget -qO cf-exclude-include.json \"$XIF\"; then EXTRA=\"$EXTRA --exclude-include-file=cf-exclude-include.json\"; echo Using client-mod exclusion list; else echo 'WARNING: could not fetch the client-mod exclusion list, continuing without it'; fi; exec ./.mih/bin/mc-image-helper install-curseforge --modpack-page-url=\"$URL\" -o \"$PWD\" --results-file=.install-results.env $EXTRA"
